title: Keep the full suite isolated under Pi
action: Keep product Pi session lookup and herding activity routing unchanged. Capture process-start Pi and herding-worker identities without a first-call race, so in-process tests ignore inherited outer identities while explicit test identities still work. Isolate every sessionless black-box subprocess in the failed targets and shared fixture set unless a test supplies its own identity. Align proof and gate fixtures with the approved exact-proof and preview contracts. Declare preview in both gate registry entries and extend deletion coverage. Pin the proof CARGO_TARGET_DIR to this worktree, so another checkout cannot replace the executable under review. Do not clear Pi or herding identity variables. Make the previously red full suite pass in both the leader and dispatched-reviewer environments.
